title: LiFUSE: Frequency-Spatial Unified Self-Supervised Pretraining for Liver Disease Analysis on Non-contrast CT
abstract: arXiv:2610.18243v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Given the growing global burden of liver tumors and diffuse liver diseases, non-contrast computed tomography (NCCT) is increasingly used for opportunistic screening because of its low cost and favorable safety profile. However, downstream tasks such as tumor detection and fine-grained disease diagnosis remain challenging due to NCCT's inherently low tissue contrast, lack of hemodynamic enhancement, and complex anatomical background. These limitations make subtle, heterogeneous, and multifocal hepatic lesions difficult to identify. Although large-scale self-supervised pretraining can learn robust representations from unlabeled NCCT scans, conventional voxel-wise reconstruction does not fully exploit the complementary information available in NCCT. translated_title: LiFUSE：面向非对比CT肝脏疾病分析的频率-空间统一自监督预训练
translated_abstract: 鉴于全球肝脏肿瘤和弥漫性肝病的负担日益加重，非对比计算机断层扫描（NCCT）因其低成本和良好的安全性，正被越来越多地用于机会性筛查。然而，由于NCCT固有的低组织对比度、缺乏血流动力学增强以及复杂的解剖背景，肿瘤检测和细粒度疾病诊断等下游任务仍然充满挑战。这些局限使得细微、异质且多灶性的肝脏病变难以识别。尽管大规模自监督预训练能够从无标注的NCCT扫描中学习到鲁棒的表征，但传统的体素级重建方法并未充分利用NCCT中蕴含的互补信息。在NCCT弱对比条件下，低层强度模式对病理识别的信息量下降，限制了对病变特异性判别特征的捕获。在本文中，我们提出……
tldr: 提出LiFUSE框架，通过统一频率域与空间域信息的自监督预训练，从无标注非对比CT中学习更具判别性的肝脏病变表征，以克服NCCT低组织对比度带来的检测与诊断难题。
en_tdlr: LiFUSE is a unified frequency-spatial self-supervised pretraining framework that learns discriminative liver lesion representations from unlabeled non-contrast CT, addressing the detection and diagnosis challenges posed by NCCT's low tissue contrast.
